_meta.definition: The process of recording, analyzing, and managing baseball player performance statistics, team statistics, and team management details.

Batting._description: Tracks individual baseball game statistics for each player in a specific season across different leagues and teams.

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: stint
columns.description: Stores the number of consecutive seasons a player spent with one team.

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the team entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: G
columns.description: Stores the total number of games played by a batter in a season.

columns.name: AB
columns.description: Stores the number of at-bats for each batting event.

columns.name: R
columns.description: Stores runs scored by a player in a game.

columns.name: H
columns.description: Stores the number of hits (at-bats without a base hit) for each batting event.

columns.name: 2B

columns.name: 3B
columns.description: Stores number of three-base hits (triples) for each batting event.

columns.name: HR

columns.name: RBI
columns.description: Stores number of runs batted in by a player.

columns.name: SB
columns.description: Stored are instances of stolen bases by batters.

columns.name: CS
columns.description: Stored are instances of caught stealing attempts by a batter.

columns.name: BB
columns.description: Stores number of walks (BB) for each player in a game.

columns.name: SO
columns.description: Strikes out count for batters during games.

columns.name: IBB
columns.description: Stored are instances of intentional base walks (intentional bases on balls) for batters.

columns.name: HBP
columns.description: Stores number of times a player was hit by a pitch during a game.

columns.name: SH

columns.name: SF
columns.description: Stores number of sacrifice flies by a player.

columns.name: GIDP
columns.description: Stored are instances of grounded into double plays by batters.

Managers._description: Tracks baseball managers and their in-season statistics for specific teams across leagues.

columns.name: playerID

columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

ManagersHalf._description: Captures baseball managers and their statistics for each half of a season across different teams, leagues, and years.

columns.name: playerID

columns.name: inseason
columns.description: Stores the season number (1, 2, 3, etc.) a manager was in charge during the first half of a game.

columns.name: half

Pitching._description: Tracks pitching statistics for individual players across Major League Baseball seasons and games.

columns.name: playerID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the player entity

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: stint
columns.description: Stores the number of consecutive seasons a pitcher played for the same team.

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the team entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: W
columns.description: Stores win-loss record of pitchers (wins).

columns.name: L
columns.description: Stored are pitcher appearances (0=did not appear, 1=pitched in one game, etc.)

columns.name: G
columns.description: Stores the number of games pitched by a player.

columns.name: GS
columns.description: Stored are counts of games started by pitchers.

columns.name: CG
columns.description: Stored are counts of complete games pitched (0 indicates no complete game).

columns.name: SHO
columns.description: Stored are indicators for games started as a pitcher (0 means did not start).

columns.name: SV
columns.description: Stored are saves (SV) by pitchers in baseball games.

columns.name: IPouts
columns.description: Stored are the total number of outs recorded by a pitcher during an inning.

columns.name: H
columns.description: Stored are pitcher's home runs allowed in a season.

columns.name: ER
columns.description: Stored are earned runs conceded by pitchers.

columns.name: HR
columns.description: Stores number of home runs conceded by a pitcher.

columns.name: BB
columns.description: Stored are the number of walks (base on balls) a pitcher has during a game.

columns.name: SO
columns.description: Stored are numbers representing strikeouts by pitchers.

columns.name: BAOpp
columns.description: Stored are opponents' batting averages against pitchers.

columns.name: ERA
columns.description: Stores pitchers' earned run averages (ERA) during a season.

columns.name: IBB
columns.description: Stores number of intentional base on balls issued by pitchers.

columns.name: WP
columns.description: Stored are Wild Pitches for pitchers in baseball games.

columns.name: HBP
columns.description: Stores number of times a pitcher was hit by a pitched ball.

columns.name: BK
columns.description: Stored are the number of times a pitcher committed a balk.

columns.name: BFP
columns.description: Stored are the number of Batter Faces Perceived by each pitcher.

columns.name: GF
columns.description: Stored are numbers representing games finished by pitchers.

columns.name: R
columns.description: Stored are numbers of relief appearances by pitchers.

columns.name: SH
columns.description: Stores the number of shutouts pitched by a player.

columns.name: SF
columns.description: Stores the number of saves credited to a pitcher.

columns.name: GIDP
columns.description: Stored are instances of ground balls turned double plays by pitchers.

columns.name: yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the year entity

columns.name: round

columns.name: L

columns.name: G

columns.name: GS

columns.name: CG
columns.description: Stores number of complete games pitched by a player.

columns.name: SHO
columns.description: Stored are indicators for starting pitchers (1) or relief pitchers (0).

columns.name: SV
columns.description: Stores number of saves by pitchers.

columns.name: IPouts
columns.description: Stores the total number of innings pitched minus batters faced (outs) for each game.

columns.name: H
columns.description: Stores pitcher's jersey number during postseason games.

columns.name: ER
columns.description: Stored are earned runs conceded by pitchers in baseball games.

columns.name: HR
columns.description: Stores number of home runs conceded by a pitcher.

columns.name: BB
columns.description: Stores the number of walks (base on errors) a pitcher has in a game.

columns.name: SO
columns.description: Stored are numbers representing strikeouts by pitchers in baseball games.

columns.name: BAOpp
columns.description: Stores opponents' batting average against a pitcher.

columns.name: ERA
columns.description: Stores pitchers' earned run averages (ERA) during a season.

columns.name: IBB
columns.description: Stored are instances of intentional base on balls (IBB) by pitchers.

columns.name: WP
columns.description: Stored are wins produced by a pitcher, indicated by non-zero integers.

columns.name: HBP
columns.description: Hits by pitch count for each pitching performance.

columns.name: BK

columns.name: GF

columns.name: R

columns.name: SH
columns.description: Stored are the number of shutouts pitched by a player.

columns.name: SF
columns.description: Stores number of saves by pitchers.

columns.name: GIDP

Teams._description: Captures statistical data for Major League Baseball teams across various seasons and leagues.

columns.name: ﻿yearID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the ﻿year entity

columns.name: lgID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the lg entity

columns.name: teamID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in Teams

columns.name: franchID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the franch entity

columns.name: divID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the div entity

columns.name: Rank
columns.description: Stores the team rankings in the league during the season.

columns.name: G
columns.description: Stores team's games played count (e.g., 31, 28, 29, 19, 33).

columns.name: Ghome
columns.description: Stores number of home games won by a team.

columns.name: W
columns.description: Stores the number of wins for each team in a baseball season.

columns.name: L
columns.description: Stores team league IDs, where 10, 9, 19, 12, 17 correspond to American League (AL), National League (NL), Pacific Coast League (PCL), International League (IL), and Minor League (MiLB) respectively.

columns.name: DivWin
columns.description: Stores whether a team won their division (Y) or not (N).

columns.name: WCWin
columns.description: Stores team's World Series win status (N = No World Series win) in Teams table.

columns.name: LgWin
columns.description: Stores team league abbreviations for wins (e.g., N for National).

columns.name: WSWin
columns.description: Stores team's win status as 'N' for no win during the season.

columns.name: R
columns.description: Stores team numbers for home games (e.g., 401 is Yankees, 302 is Oakland A's)

columns.name: AB
columns.description: Stores total at-bats for each team in a baseball season.

columns.name: H
columns.description: Stores team IDs in LahmanBaseball database.

columns.name: 2B
columns.description: Stored are the number of two-base hits (doubles) for each team.

columns.name: 3B
columns.description: Stores team IDs for third base coaches.

columns.name: HR
columns.description: Stores total home runs scored by a team in a season.

columns.name: BB
columns.description: Stores team IDs as integers, possibly indicating different leagues (e.g., 60 for American League, 26 for National League).

columns.name: SO
columns.description: Stores the number of saves by a baseball team during a season.

columns.name: SB
columns.description: Stored are total stolen bases for each team in a season.

columns.name: CS
columns.description: Stored are the number of times a team successfully executed a double play.

columns.name: HBP
columns.description: Stores the number of times a team was hit by pitches during a season.

columns.name: SF
columns.description: Stores whether a team is from San Francisco (0 = no, unused).

columns.name: RA
columns.description: Stored are runs allowed by a team in a season (RA), as indicated by sample values.

columns.name: ER
columns.description: Stores total errors committed by a baseball team during a season.

columns.name: ERA
columns.description: Stores team's earned run average (ERA) in baseball games.

columns.name: CG
columns.description: Stores number of complete games pitched by a team.

columns.name: SHO
columns.description: Stores team's status for home games (1=home, 0=away).

columns.name: SV
columns.description: Stores the number of times a team won a pennant (SV = Series Victory).

columns.name: IPouts
columns.description: Stores total number of innings pitched by a team, including outs made.

columns.name: HA
columns.description: Stores home arena ID for baseball teams.

columns.name: HRA
columns.description: Stores home run averages for baseball teams.

columns.name: BBA
columns.description: Stores team identifiers for Baseball Almanac (BBA) in the Teams table.

columns.name: SOA
columns.description: Stores sequence of team appearances in the World Series order of finish.

columns.name: E
columns.description: Stores team IDs in the LahmanBaseball database.

columns.name: DP
columns.description: Stores the number of double plays executed by a baseball team.

columns.name: FP
columns.description: Stores team's Pythagorean winning percentage, a statistical measure predicting win-loss record based on runs scored and allowed.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of team names from the 19th century baseball era.

columns.name: park
columns.description: Stores names of baseball parks associated with teams.

columns.name: attendance
columns.description: Stores the number of spectators at baseball games for each team.

columns.name: BPF
columns.description: Stores franchise identifiers for baseball teams (103, 104, 96, 101, 90 correspond to Boston Red Sox, Oakland Athletics, Houston Astros, New York Yankees, and Chicago Cubs respectively).

columns.name: PPF
columns.description: Stores total home games won by a team in a season (PPF stands for Park Factored Wins at Home).

columns.name: teamIDBR
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for baseball teams (e.g., BOS, CHI, CLE, KEK, NYU) in a 10-character format.

columns.name: teamIDlahman45
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for Major League Baseball teams in the LahmanBaseball database (2019 version).

columns.name: teamIDretro
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for teams in retroactive seasons (e.g., BS1 for 1876 Boston Red Stockings).

columns.name: DivWin

columns.name: Rank

columns.name: G

columns.name: W

columns.name: L
